Penanganan Autokorelasi

Metode Cochrane-Orcutt

modelco1<-cochrane.orcutt(model1)
summary(modelco1)
## Call:
## lm(formula = y ~ x)
## 
##               Estimate Std. Error t value  Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)  1.0829961  0.0202656  53.440 < 2.2e-16 ***
## x           -0.0374514  0.0029661 -12.627 4.601e-10 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 0.0156 on 17 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.9036 ,  Adjusted R-squared:  0.898
## F-statistic: 159.4 on 1 and 17 DF,  p-value: < 4.601e-10
## 
## Durbin-Watson statistic 
## (original):    1.15126 , p-value: 1.099e-02
## (transformed): 2.09351 , p-value: 5.266e-01
rho<-modelco1$rho
price.trans<- y[-1]-y[-length(y)]*rho
marketshare.trans<- x[-1]-x[-length(x)]*rho
modelco1manual<- lm(price.trans~marketshare.trans)
summary(modelco1manual)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = price.trans ~ marketshare.trans)
## 
## Residuals:
##       Min        1Q    Median        3Q       Max 
## -0.024204 -0.010506 -0.002757  0.008285  0.030463 
## 
## Coefficients:
##                    Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)        0.638632   0.011950   53.44  < 2e-16 ***
## marketshare.trans -0.037451   0.002966  -12.63  4.6e-10 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 0.01558 on 17 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.9036, Adjusted R-squared:  0.898 
## F-statistic: 159.4 on 1 and 17 DF,  p-value: 4.601e-10
b0star <- modelco1manual$coefficients[-2]
b0 <- b0star/(1-rho)
b1 <- modelco1manual$coefficients[-1]
b0
## (Intercept) 
##    1.082996
b1
## marketshare.trans 
##       -0.03745137

Metode Hildreth-Lu

r <- seq(0, 0.9, by = 0.1)
tab <- data.frame(
  rho = r,
  SSE = sapply(r, function(rr) deviance(hildreth.lu(y, x, rr)))
)

tab            
##    rho         SSE
## 1  0.0 0.005002545
## 2  0.1 0.004628589
## 3  0.2 0.004358506
## 4  0.3 0.004192070
## 5  0.4 0.004129318
## 6  0.5 0.004170959
## 7  0.6 0.004318978
## 8  0.7 0.004577012
## 9  0.8 0.004949366
## 10 0.9 0.005438125
rho_hat <- tab$rho[which.min(tab$SSE)]   
modelhl1  <- hildreth.lu(y, x, rho_hat)    
summary(modelhl1)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = y ~ x)
## 
## Residuals:
##       Min        1Q    Median        3Q       Max 
## -0.024136 -0.010467 -0.002726  0.008125  0.030406 
## 
## Coefficients:
##              Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)  0.649945   0.012017   54.08  < 2e-16 ***
## x           -0.037485   0.002936  -12.77 3.88e-10 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 0.01559 on 17 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.9055, Adjusted R-squared:    0.9 
## F-statistic:   163 on 1 and 17 DF,  p-value: 3.88e-10
hildreth.lu.func<- function(r, model1){
  x <- model.matrix(model1)[,-1]
  y <- model.response(model.frame(model1))
  n <- length(y)
  t <- 2:n
  y <- y[t]-r*y[t-1]
  x <- x[t]-r*x[t-1]
  
  return(lm(y~x))
}

r <- c(seq(0.1,0.9, by= 0.1))
tab <- data.frame("rho" = r, "SSE" = sapply(r, function(i){deviance(hildreth.lu.func(i, model1))}))
tab
##   rho         SSE
## 1 0.1 0.004628589
## 2 0.2 0.004358506
## 3 0.3 0.004192070
## 4 0.4 0.004129318
## 5 0.5 0.004170959
## 6 0.6 0.004318978
## 7 0.7 0.004577012
## 8 0.8 0.004949366
## 9 0.9 0.005438125
rOpt <- seq(0.3,0.5, by= 0.001)
tabOpt <- data.frame("rho" = rOpt, "SSE" = sapply(rOpt, function(i){deviance(hildreth.lu.func(i, model1))}))
head(tabOpt[order(tabOpt$SSE),])
##       rho         SSE
## 111 0.410 0.004128764
## 112 0.411 0.004128766
## 110 0.409 0.004128772
## 113 0.412 0.004128778
## 109 0.408 0.004128791
## 114 0.413 0.004128801
par(mfrow = c(1,1))
plot(tab$SSE ~ tab$rho , type = "l", xlab = "Rho", ylab = "SSE")
abline(v = tabOpt[tabOpt$SSE==min(tabOpt$SSE),"rho"], lty = 2, col="red",lwd=2)
text(x = min(tabOpt$rho), 
     y = min(tabOpt$SSE), 
     labels = paste("rho =", 0.41), 
     cex = 0.9,
     adj=c(0,-2))

modelhlmanual1 <- hildreth.lu.func(0.41, model1)
summary(modelhlmanual1)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = y ~ x)
## 
## Residuals:
##       Min        1Q    Median        3Q       Max 
## -0.024202 -0.010505 -0.002756  0.008280  0.030461 
## 
## Coefficients:
##              Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)  0.638972   0.011952   53.46  < 2e-16 ***
## x           -0.037452   0.002965  -12.63 4.58e-10 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 0.01558 on 17 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.9037, Adjusted R-squared:  0.898 
## F-statistic: 159.5 on 1 and 17 DF,  p-value: 4.578e-10
cat("y = ", coef(modelhlmanual1)[1]/(1-0.41), " + ", "(", coef(modelhlmanual1)[2], ")", "x", sep = "")
## y = 1.083004 + (-0.03745239)x
